about: First picture set to label for a ball detector. Development footage only (before 2026-10-17); Oct 17 sessions and the recorder run are kept for testing. prefill = the app's own guesses in picture pixels, to check and correct, never truth. For each picture a reviewer marks every ball (centre and radius), its number where readable, and leaves the number blank where it is not.
